newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield rises to 58.46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield rises to 58.46 pct.

text.p: The average yield on an issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 58.46 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 56.96 percent at the previous auction of six-month paper on October 23, the central bank said.
Full details of the auction follow:
Issue volume 9.00 trln rbls 8.00 trln rbls
On October 30 the finance ministry is also auctioning three trillion roubles in a new tranche of six-month T-bills (series 22042).
Dealers forecast the average yield at the auction to be in the 50.20-60.20 percent range. The yield on the new tranche of six-month bills (series 22042) is seen in the 49.90-60.82 percent range.
The series 22045 six-month bills, closest in maturity to the 22056 bills, closed at a yield of 55.98 percent on Tuesday.
The finance ministry will also repay about 7.79 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22031).
